turns.text: Hello. I would like to return a catalogue print. It does not suit the wall.
Hello! Could you send me your order number and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll check whether the print can be returned.
The order is SC-5211 and the email is ysolde.macinca@example.com. It arrived within the last two weeks.
I’ve filed your return request for order SC-5211. Your reference is R-1. The request is pending staff approval.
I will pay the return postage. Please file the return for the team to approve. I am not asking for a reprint.
Your return request for order SC-5211 is already filed under reference R-1 and is awaiting staff approval. No reprint was requested.
